Under Medium stand the fail-open .env.dist defaults, the deploy CI does not gate, the dead form hook and the save a Google failure blocks. The two changelog lookups at 16:57:48 asked for identifiers the reading found, before finding 5 judged one of them. Finding 1 cites security-sinks as its Rule and stays High. The kinds stay apart under the report's headings. High to Low hold defects with an Evidence line marked verified or reasoned. Recommendation holds the Rector batch and the redundant ext_tables.sql column. Open holds five questions, each with what would settle it. Dropped holds two disproved candidates with their reason. Checked and correct holds five claims that held. The key, the env defaults, the geocoding hook and the dev branches carry Owner unassigned, which marks them as work no TYPO3 workflow here owns.

The report ends on Not reached, then a seven-step order by finding number with the skill for each. The last line asks which items to take on. The session changed no file. Every finding names typo3-content-element-development, typo3-extension-testing, typo3-extension-upgrade, typo3-extension-asset-build, typo3-sitepackage-development or unassigned. failures.evidence: No finding is a TYPO3 checklist item without a place in this checkout. Each names a file of site-events or a value a call returned for it. The sitepackage hints the brief carried and omitted left no mark on the report.

The missing tests stand in finding 7 with the concrete code they leave unguarded, and findings 1 and 5 as the cost. The Rector batch and the redundant column stand under Recommendation. The production .env and the Maps key restriction stand under Open with what would confirm each. The getenv fallback was dropped after the session read additional.php:7-8.

typo3_ter_lookup returned empty, and finding 8 reads it as an unpublished package rather than a missing release. The runtime lookups the session skipped stand under Not reached with the lookups they would be. The production .env it could not read goes to Open, not to a verdict. Finding 5 rests on a grep of the installed EXT:form, and its Evidence line says the rendered form went unchecked.

Every check the session ran is the project's own composer script, t3g:cgl, t3g:phpstan and t3g:rector, under DDEV, as typo3_project_describe declared them. No core command or core process appears. The deprecation sweep stands as exempt under Not reached, which base.md grants a task that writes nothing.

git status in site-events was clean on develop at 1123b1e before and after the run. The transcript carries no Edit or Write. The three checks are dry runs by their composer definitions, and the extra rector call passes --dry-run. gh repo view only reads the repository's visibility.
